basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pathology at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, has invited applications for one Project Technical Support-II (Data Management) post on contract in an ICMR-funded extramural project running up to September 2029. The pay is Rs.20,000/- + 20% HRA = Rs. 24,000/-. The essential qualification is 12th in science plus a diploma and five years' experience, or a bachelor's degree in a computer-related field. Applications go by email to [email protected], and the last date is 30 November 2026, until 11.30 PM.

important_dates.interview_date: Date and time notified one week in advance

qualification.details: Minimum 3 years' experience in data entry work. Knowledge of Computer Applications or Business Intelligence tools/Data Management. Experience in handling clinical research data and patient-related data in Oncology or other clinical areas. Proficient in computer skills (MS Office, word, excel, cloud storage, PowerPoint). Proficient in research database management, REDCap preferred. Knowledge of data quality control methods and audits. Working knowledge of statistical software including SPSS/Stata/R. | The notice states that qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For the full wording of the eligibility, refer to the official notification.

how_to_apply: Fill in the attached application form (REC-03). It is to be printed on A4 paper and filled in block letters with a blue pen.
Attach a recent photograph, a two-page CV and the supporting documents listed below, scanned in one PDF.
Name the PDF file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PTS-II_2026_application".
Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.
Email the application to [email protected] so that it is received by 11.30 PM on 30 November 2026.
To apply for two or more different posts, fill a separate application form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email.
Valid photo ID and address proof.

The application form's checklist asks for self-attested certificates attached in order: proof of identity (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License), age proof (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate), degrees/diplomas, experience certificates and any other relevant documents. The form also asks for previous employers' contact details and says applicants should inform those persons.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Applications with a CV alone and without the prescribed form and certificates will be rejected. Incomplete applications, and those that do not fulfil the essential criteria, are likely to be summarily rejected. Wrong or false information, or canvassing of any kind, leads to disqualification, or termination if detected after engagement. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry

"Development and Validation of a Pan-India Multi-Centric Machine Learning Model for the Prediction of Hemoglobinopathies and Discrimination from Iron Deficiency Anemia Using Complete Blood Count Parameters"
Project duration up to September 2029; initial appointment for six months, with extension based on performance

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints two essential qualification lines for the post. 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering/Computer science/Computer application/Electronic & communication) + Five Years Experience in the relevant subject/field. Bachelor's degree in computer application/IT/Computer science/Electronic & Communication from a recognized institution/university. The age limit is up to 30 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline or field and in a reputed institution or organization, and the experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Minimum 3 years' experience in data entry work. Knowledge of Computer Applications or Business Intelligence tools/Data Management. Experience in handling clinical research data and patient-related data in Oncology or other clinical areas. Proficient in computer skills (MS Office, word, excel, cloud storage, PowerPoint). Proficient in research database management, REDCap preferred. Knowledge of data quality control methods and audits. Working knowledge of statistical software including SPSS/Stata/R. The notice states that qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For the full wording of the eligibility, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is Rs.20,000/- + 20% HRA = Rs. 24,000/-. The notice says the consolidated salary may vary from time to time and that no other allowance or facilities will be extended beyond the consolidated salary. The project runs up to September 2029. The initial appointment will be for six months, with extension based on performance. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator. The position is only for the duration of the project and depends on external funding. The person engaged has no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Collection of data from Research Nurse/site clinical contact. Input data into the study database (real-time). Coordination with the Centre (regular updates, meetings, and data audit activities). Management of site monitoring visits with completion of follow-up actions to monitoring queries. Maintenance of study documentation. Ensure data confidentiality, security, and compliance with all GCP standards and rules. Prepare weekly/monthly data summary and project dashboard. Miscellaneous office and administrative work related to the project. Participate in all study-related activities and discharge other duties assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the attached application form (REC-03). It is to be printed on A4 paper and filled in block letters with a blue pen. Attach a recent photograph, a two-page CV and the supporting documents listed below, scanned in one PDF. Name the PDF file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PTS-II_2026_application". Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line. Email the application to [email protected] so that it is received by 11.30 PM on 30 November 2026. To apply for two or more different posts, fill a separate application form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email. CV (filled in application form/annexure 1). Birth certificate / proof of DOB. Valid photo ID and address proof. Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC), if applicable. Certificate(s) of academic qualifications. Experience certificate (work and research). Scientific publications. Personal statement. Reference letters (one or two). The application form's checklist asks for self-attested certificates attached in order: proof of identity (Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License), age proof (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate), degrees/diplomas, experience certificates and any other relevant documents. The form also asks for previous employers' contact details and says applicants should inform those persons.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on the details in the application form, CV and documentary proof. Shortlisted candidates receive an email confirmation with details and the date of the test and Walk-In Interview. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Written test: areas and syllabus relate to the disciplines and criteria in the eligibility and to the expected roles and responsibilities. Interview: areas and syllabus are the same as for the written test. It is held in person at the Department of Pathology, IInd floor, Institute Block, JIPMER, Puducherry, and its date and time will be notified one week in advance. The final selection is based on CV, application, written test and interview. Only shortlisted candidates are called for a written test and/or interview, and the decision of the Project Investigator is final. If applications are very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to decide eligibility. The notice does not give the test or interview date.
